verdict.rationale: llamafile runs entirely on the user's own device with no cloud and no data sharing, so data resides wherever the user chooses to run it. The docs describe the server sandbox as blocking outbound connections, and a hands-on user reports it ran with zero network connection. Missing for 10: no explicit documentation framing this as data residency or locality control, and no details on where any persisted data (e.g., chat history or uploads) is written.
